text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH error rate detected in eu-west1 gateway - 5xx surge and increased 504s for inference-routes. Alerting SRE and Runtime on-call. Pager: pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345

sre-ana: acked. I'm on it. grabbing initial graphs.

observability-bot: summary: 10m spike, 5xx rate = 18% (baseline 0.2%), median latency up from 120ms -> 900ms, p95 ~ 3.2s. Top upstream: mlworker-eu-west1 returning 502/504. request_id example: rq_7f3a9b2c.

runtime-jay: seeing a lot of KV cache misses and long tail in model worker responses. Could be worker saturation or slow I/O to model shard. pulling `kubectl get pods -n runtime -l app=mlworker -o wide`.

infra-lin: checking node metrics.. some GPU nodes show high CPU/IO wait and OOM kills around 02:10. possible memory leak in latest canary of model-serve v2.3.5.

sre-ana: steps: 1) open circuit for eu-west gateway to divert to eu-central fallback pool, 2) scale up mlworker replicas in eu-west temporarily, 3) roll back canary if correlated. who can run the routing flip?

eng-oncall-dave: I can do the route flip. Preparing the route policy change: `redwoodctl route modify --region eu-west1 --fallback-region eu-central --threshold 0.05` (dry-run first).

runtime-jay: important: make sure fallback model variant is compatible (same tokenizer/weights compatibility). I'll enable model-variant `gptq-16-small` fallback which is cheaper and resilient to OOMs.

infra-lin: scaling mlworker eu-west: `kubectl scale deploy/mlworker --replicas=24 -n runtime`. Doing now.

support-elena: heads up: some enterprise customers pinned to `model-id: redwood/super-large-2025` may see degraded outputs if routed to fallback. drafting an outbound to affected customers now.

customer-success-frank: please add customer A and B to priority list — they reported errors at 02:18.

sre-ana: route flip in progress. executing `redwoodctl route apply --policy emergency-eu-west-failover` — applying. will monitor for error drop.

incident-bot: runbook triggered: `eu-region-failover` by sre-ana at 2026-03-15T02:22:10Z.

observability-bot: after route change: 5xx rate in eu-west fell from 18% -> 6% in 2m, end-to-end latency p95 down to 1.1s. eu-central ingress increased by ~12% load.

eng-oncall-dave: routing change completed. Verified traffic now split 60/40 eu-west/eu-central with graceful drain.

runtime-jay: scaled replicas up completed. watching heap profiles. initial heap dumps indicate a native memory leak in `tokenizer-worker` in v2.3.5. correlates with deploy at 01:58.

infra-lin: starting rollback of model-serve canary from v2.3.5 -> v2.3.4. `kubectl set image deploy/model-serve model-serve=registry/redwood/model-serve:v2.3.4 -n runtime`

support-elena: outbound sent to affected customers (incidents@customer, cs@). message: "We detected elevated 5xx in eu-west. We've routed traffic to eu-central and applied mitigations. Some pinned models may see fallback; we're investigating root cause and will provide ETA."

pm-carol: flagged product impact: feature flags for high-throughput customers should be reviewed for unsafe requests that amplify load. putting follow-up on postmortem.

sre-ana: rollback done; observing reduced OOMs. eu-west worker OOMs stopped ~02:33. 5xx now stable ~0.9% region-wide.

runtime-jay: final check: KV cache warm-up in eu-west will take ~10-12 minutes; expect short-term latency blips until warmed. planning to gradually shift traffic back after 20m stable.

eng-oncall-dave: handing off to next oncall (sre-ana -> eng-oncall-2) at 02:45. summary for handoff: "eu-west1 partial degradation due to model-serve v2.3.5 memory regression causing OOMs -> increased 5xx/504. Mitigations: scaled mlworkers, rolled back canary, applied region failover to eu-central, enabled fallback model variant. Error rate reduced to baseline. Customer impact: transient errors and degraded outputs for pinned-model customers. Actions: monitor cache warm-up and confirm no further regressions, run heap-analysis job, prepare postmortem."

customer-success-frank: noted. I'll follow up with impacted accounts and schedule 1:1s.

support-elena: support queue cleared for priority tickets. collecting logs from affected customer sessions to attach to postmortem.

incident-bot: incident annotated: severity=SEV2, start=2026-03-15T02:18:25Z, mitigated=2026-03-15T02:34:50Z, owner=sre-ana.

pm-carol: scheduled postmortem meeting 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC. owner: runtime-jay. deliverables: hotfix timeline, release gating improvements, runbook updates.

sre-ana: closing thread for now. Will keep monitoring and reopen if metrics worsen. :white_check_mark:
